## 0.46.9

- **New - "Among your spec":** the Matrix now shows how your lenses, armor, biggest hits
  and more rank against other players of your class and level, plus a daily featured
  challenge that matches wow-foresight.web.app. It fills in as more players share.
- **New - the engine panel follows your character:** it leads with your biggest hits right
  now and only shows abilities you've actually learned, framing the rest as what to build
  toward - no more listing a spec you don't have yet.
- **Fix:** `/foresight share` no longer risks tripping WoW's "action blocked" protection.
- **Smaller share link:** `/foresight share` is much shorter and easier to copy.

Toggle the crowd comparison any time with `/foresight options`.
